identity.title: External-Reconstruction B0 Qualification Contract Extension
identity.objective: Add exactly one external-reconstruction B0 rule literal EXTERNAL_PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 and exactly one qualification feature source class MARKET_EXTERNAL_RECONSTRUCTION with rule-specific B2 source-class coupling, so S10-QUAL-DATA-02 third-party reconstruction evidence can be described without relabelling it canonical PIT. Canonical PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 / MARKET_PIT semantics, QUALIFICATION_SCHEMA_VERSION 1.0.0 and every existing canonical candidate identity stay unchanged; no gate, WP170, DATA-02, dependency, workflow, network or data authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-QUAL-B0X-01. The external B0 literal, the MARKET_EXTERNAL_RECONSTRUCTION class and the rule-to-class coupling disappear; canonical packets and ids are unaffected because they never changed.

api_matrix.reason: No product, venue or trading API is added; the change is additive offline validator vocabulary and coupling in qualification.py.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules freeze the two B0 literals, the canonical and external B0 semantics, the additive source class, B1/B2 coupling, canonical identity invariants, the unchanged gate, authority and successor boundary.

items.required_rule: b0_rule is exactly PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 or EXTERNAL_PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1; any other value rejects FORECAST_PLAN_INVALID.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 semantics, parameters, MARKET_PIT coupling and canonical candidate identities are unchanged.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: EXTERNAL_PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 uses the same max_midpoint_spread [0,1] and nonnegative integer max_last_trade_age_seconds; midpoint only for an observed two-sided book with recomputed ask-bid <= max_midpoint_spread; else latest observed last trade within age; else unavailable; NOT_OBSERVED_IN_SEARCHED_HOURS never imputed; observability is external capture timestamp_received <= decision_time; Last-Modified/public_available_time never backdates; never MARKET_PIT, SOURCE_KIND_CANONICAL_PIT, DatasetSnapshotReference or local_first_seen_time.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: QUALIFICATION_FEATURE_SOURCE_CLASSES gains exactly MARKET_EXTERNAL_RECONSTRUCTION appended after the unchanged canonical three.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure
